title: Code by Zapier step times out on the Free plan though it ran fine in a paid trial
symptoms: Code step fails with a timeout error in Zap history
Same code works during the trial and fails after it ends
fetch calls inside the step never complete
cause: Code steps run for 1 second on Free, 30 seconds on Professional and Team, and 2 minutes on Enterprise, and a trial gets the limits of the plan being trialed.
fix: Keep Code steps short on Free, move HTTP calls to a Webhooks or app step, or use extended runtimes on paid plans.
apply: Zap editor > Code by Zapier step > Open in Code Editor > Runtime icon > Extended runtime
affected: Code by Zapier, all plans, as of 2026-10
